create.name: Stephan Pende Wormland
create.bio:
Stephan Pende Wormland is a German-born meditation teacher living in Copenhagen who joins Tibetan Buddhist practice with Western psychology. He was an ordained monk in the Tibetan tradition for eleven years, about five of them in group and solitary retreat, and for a period directed Nalanda Monastery in the south of France. Lama Zopa Rinpoche, who died in 2023, was his principal teacher and authorised him to teach, and he has also learned from Alan Wallace, Rob Preece, Pema Chödrön and others. He holds an MA in clinical psychology, trained in Gestalt therapy and spent six years working in a psychiatric hospital. Since 2009 he has studied Peter Fenner's Radiant Mind approach to nondual awareness.

He has taught in Buddhist centres since 2001 and was for many years the resident teacher of a Copenhagen centre for wisdom and compassion. These days he leads drop-in evenings and practice afternoons in Copenhagen, city weekends and week-long silent retreats in Austria, Denmark, Sweden and Italy, some of them with his wife Kristina, and sessions on Zoom. His teaching ranges from classic texts and methods such as Shantideva, the Lam Rim, Mahamudra and lojong to simple invitations to rest in awareness, offered with warmth and a fair amount of humour. Hundreds of his recorded talks and meditations are free to hear online.

courses.title: Drop-In Meditation – When Things Fall Apart
courses.description: Fortnightly Tuesday evenings at Karmapa Trust in central Copenhagen, loosely built around Pema Chödrön's book on meeting uncertainty. Each evening mixes a short teaching, guided sitting and conversation, and newcomers can simply turn up without booking.

courses.title: Just drop it! – Practice Afternoon
courses.description: A four-hour Saturday session in Ørestad, Copenhagen, on the direct path of resting in being rather than following thought. Guided and silent sitting alternate with light mindful movement, and it suits beginners as well as long-time meditators.

courses.title: City Retreat in Graz
courses.description: A German-language weekend of meditation in Graz, Austria, which can also be joined on Zoom. Taking Tara Brach's True Refuge as a starting point, it explores coming home to oneself through stillness, breath and compassion.
courses.price: €110 EUR (plus €40 EUR room fee on site)

courses.title: Christmas & New Year Vipassana Retreat
courses.description: A silent week on the Danish island of Bornholm over the holidays, taught with Kristina for at most eight people. Breath concentration leads into vipassana, observing body sensations with equanimity, with interviews and check-ins along the way; meals and shared rooms are included.

courses.title: Werde still und erkenne dich selbst
courses.description: A five-day German-language retreat at a guesthouse in Semriach, Styria, on starting and keeping up a daily practice. It covers breath, body awareness, compassion and insight meditation, with talks drawn from Tibetan Buddhism in an open, non-dogmatic way.
courses.price: €430 EUR (double) or €470 EUR (single) board and lodging, plus teaching by dana (€350 EUR suggested)

courses.title: Assisi Easter Retreat
courses.description: A week of silence and devotion in Assisi over Easter, staying at a quiet country house a short walk from the basilica. Days include a dawn walk to the saint's tomb, several hours of meditation, singing, forgiveness practice and time in spring nature, for up to twelve people.

courses.title: Freude und Stille
courses.description: A German-language retreat week at the Buddhist centre in Scheibbs, Austria, combining silent sitting and walking, simple qigong, mantra singing and talks. It looks at the Tibetan idea of a joy that does not depend on circumstances and is open to all levels.
courses.price: Teaching by dana; house costs 496 EUR

courses.title: Loving Awareness – A silent Retreat
courses.description: Five days of silence in Tyresö, near Stockholm, centred on heart practices from the Tibetan tradition. Sitting and walking meditation, guided heart practice and gentle inquiry fill the days, with phones, news and social media set aside.

free_resources.title: Stephan Pende Wormland on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A set of his guided meditations and talks drawn from Tibetan Buddhist practice, free to listen to in the app or browser. There is also a Copenhagen group linked to his profile.

free_resources.title: Natural Meditation podcast
free_resources.description: His SoundCloud archive of several hundred recordings, in English and German: retreat talks, guided sittings and teaching series on topics such as Mahamudra and lojong. Everything is free to stream.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 19.8k followers (profile, 1 Nov 2026); YouTube @StephanPendeWormland 2.07K subscribers (channel header, 1 Nov 2026); SoundCloud 'Natural Meditation podcast' 2,951 followers (page data, 1 Nov 2026); Instagram @stephanpende 1,976 (og:description, 1 Nov 2026); Facebook 'Natural Meditation' page 1,538 (og:description, 1 Nov 2026) → ~28.3k total → local_hero
flags: Health rule, borderline (owner to judge): his Spiritual Mentoring page lists 'support in times of fear, depression, anxiety, stress or grief' among what one-to-one sessions offer, and a coaching testimonial mentions managing anxiety. The rest of the site, his YouTube and all current events are mainly traditional Buddhist and nondual teaching, so I wrote the plan; mentoring, coaching and supervision are left out. Owner may prefer to skip, as with Camilla Sacre-Dallerup.

Plant medicine: a January 2025 blog post ('Welcome to a New Chapter') says his main focus will be joint work with his wife Kristina, described as a plant-medicine shaman working with ayahuasca ('Queen of the Forest'), and mentions plant-medicine integration and cacao ceremonies. No current event on his calendar is plant-medicine based, but the owner may want to weigh this against the Esalen plant-medicine skips.
Last Insight Timer upload was about 7 years ago; his YouTube uploads are 4 to 6 years old. His live teaching calendar is current (events through August 2027).

YouTube titles copied as published, including the typo 'Give up your Live'. Only the 30 most recent uploads (of 209) could be read without the internal API, so the picks are the most-viewed among those, not necessarily the channel's most-viewed overall.
The 'Just drop it!' afternoon sits at an odd URL slug (/event/become-your-own-healer-2/) on his site; it is the correct page for that event.
Several offerings are taught in German (Graz, Semriach, Scheibbs) or co-led with Kristina (Bornholm, probably Assisi); the Tyresö retreat is booked through local organisers by email, not on his site.
Email is a gmail address his site describes as reaching his personal assistant.
left_out: Spiritual Mentoring (100 EUR a session): its page names depression and anxiety among what sessions support, health rule.
Mindfulness Coaching (100 EUR a session): stress and work-life framing is fine, but the page carries an anxiety/CBT testimonial; left out to be safe.

Professional Supervision (for therapists) and Lectures (themes include 'mindfulness in medicine and psychotherapy', 'burnout prophylaxis', and a 'Healing Power of Mind' transcript on visualisation healing the body): clinical or health framing.
Become your own healer (Copenhagen afternoon, 21 Nov 2026): 'healer' title and emotional-healing framing, and its listing shows an implausible €1,000 ticket price; borderline, left out.
Blog post 'Living Differently: A Pathway to Embrace and Transform Pain': pain-management framing.
Past event (online drop-in meditation from Assisi, 13 Oct 2026): passed. A blog post about a weekend in Bern ('Gehe an die Orte die du fürchtest') was not checked for dates and not listed.
No books of his own found on Amazon; no Insight Timer courses on his profile.
Short YouTube clips 'Paying tender attention' and 'INTER - BEING' (about 1 minute): under the 2-minute minimum.
